static_traits.name: 林远
static_traits.social_status: 有少量朋友可交流Average事务，但not yet与他们讨论自己的not安全感
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高，语速与语调平稳但Low mood；思维倾向聚焦负面并跳到结论与自我标签；能接受重构并愿意尝试行动

basic_info.main_problem: 近期与Female友分手后not安全感显著加重，长期存在的not安全与自我not足在关系与社交中恶化，常自责并感到“not够好”，Being alone或社交场景时易跳到负面结论。
basic_info.core_demands: 因分手及not安全感对关系的影响而寻求咨询，希望提升自尊并改善社交互动。
growth_experiences: 在过往的恋爱关系中长期感到not安全与自我not足，这一模式在当下关系破裂后进一步加重。

core_beliefs: 我是令人厌烦的，会把人逼走

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在亲密关系中表现出not安全或not完美，就说明I am not worthy of being loved、并且一定会被抛弃
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复自责、回避向他人（朋友）透露not安全感，尝试通过分散注意与自助书籍自我修复
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她离开我是因为我的not安全感，It is all my fault。

special_situations.event: Interacting with others in social scenes (colleagues, band members, audience)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人对我have not明确的正面反馈，就意味着他们在negate我或觉得我很烦
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在互动中not断二次猜测与Self-monitoring，尽量压低自我表达以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定觉得我not好/很烦人。

special_situations.event: 演出出现失误与技术问题后回看整场演出
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once an obvious mistake occurs, it equals the whole thing failing; my worth is completely defined by the mistake
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 持续反刍错误并忽视积极片段，企图通过过度Reflection来避免再次犯错
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些错误毁了整场演出。

special_situations.event: Being alone时回想关系与工作中的表现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我现在感觉not够好，就会一直搞砸事情，not yet来也not会好转
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-soothes through distraction, but lacks seeking help from others and reality testing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会继续搞砸一切，not人会真正认可我。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可并拥有稳定的亲密关系
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected与被抛弃，担心他人将自己定义为“not够好/令人厌烦”
defense_goal: 通过Self-denial与过度反省来控制风险、避免更糟的评价
Repression与回避暴露脆弱以维持表面安全

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、令人厌烦、容易犯错的被评价者
object_relations.object_representation: Evaluators/rejecters who may be critical and ultimately reject or abandon me

object_relations.self_representation: 因错误而被全盘negate的失败者
object_relations.object_representation: 只关注错误、忽视优点的挑剔旁观者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to look back at the performance from a whole perspective and try to view the mistake as 'part of the event' rather than 'the whole'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识担心这会被理解为在淡化问题，或担心自己的感受not被认真对待，从而加重被negate的恐惧
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: The tone is gentle and specific: first name and validate their disappointment and shame, then use fact comparison and proportional reframing (listing positive and negative segments of the performance), avoid judgment, and invite them with open questions to describe subtle changes in their feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师鼓励其与朋友或队友讨论not安全感、寻求现实反馈与支持时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Imagines possible acceptance as rejection, believing exposing vulnerability will lead to relationship rupture or being labeled 'trouble'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持支持性语气，use探询证据的方式区分假设与事实，鼓励小步尝试（先与最安全的对象沟通），并设置具体可观察的反馈点以降低not确定性。

manifestations: Being alone时not安全感与自我not足感显著加剧
害怕他人negate而减少向他人求助与表达脆弱

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the behavioral impulse he wants to make toward others or the outside world, instead doing it to himself, turning the energy originally intended to be sent outward back onto the self.
manifestations: not与朋友谈及not安全感，将表达与寻求支持的冲动压回自我
在互动中二次猜测与自我苛责而非外向沟通

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 假设他人对自己有负面看法（读心术）
将少量失误理解为“所有人都在negate我”

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁Self-denial与二次猜测，降低表达与探索
Overly cautious in teamwork, confidence declines, affecting interaction quality

positive_force: Proactively seeks counseling and is willing to try new methods (communicating with teammates, reframing perspectives)
具备一定的自我觉察能力，能识do not并命名自己的not安全感与思维模式
拥有基础社会支持（有几位朋友可交流Average事务）
Willing to do behavioral experiments and small-step attempts, with motivation to learn and adjust
negative_force: 长期not安全感与自我not足感，倾向自我责备
跳到结论（读心术、预测not yet来）与心理过滤，放大错误
回避披露脆弱，减少现实检验与支持获取
Long working hours and high stress, emotions and sleep and eating affected

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交场景中读心与Self-denial（紧张、认为他人负面评价自己）
antecedent: 社交互动（同事、乐队成员、观众）
target_behavior.core_reason: 源于“I am not good enough/令人厌烦”的核心信念与过往关系中的not安全感，伴随跳到结论与外部评价敏感
target_behavior.function: 逃避Being rejected或负面评价、获得表观的控制与安全感
target_behavior.consequence: 信心下降、Interpersonal tension，Work performance affected，Persistent anxiety并影响睡眠与饮食

target_behavior.behavior: After performances, catastrophically ruminates on mistakes with mental filtering (defining a few slips as overall failure)
antecedent: 演出中出现失误或技术问题后回看整场演出
target_behavior.core_reason: 灾难化与心理过滤导致忽视积极部分，Reinforcement“错误=失败=I am not good enough”的信念
target_behavior.function: 试图通过过度Reflection避免再次犯错（寻求控制感）
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood、与队友互动紧张、持续二次猜测，影响整体表现与自尊

target_behavior.behavior: 回避向朋友表达not安全感与寻求支持
antecedent: 想到要与朋友谈及自己的not安全感
担心被评判或When feeling ashamed
target_behavior.core_reason: 个人化与Being rejected恐惧，使其将脆弱视为会导致关系恶化的风险
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与羞耻感，维持表面安全
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient use of social support、Loneliness感增加，not安全感与Self-denial维持
